findings.title: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Cancellation Policy URL Uploads in Rate Plans
findings.attacker: An authenticated administrator or malicious employee with access to the portal rate plans module.
findings.attack_path: The attacker navigates to modules/hotel_booking_portal_rate_plans/create.php or edit.php, inputs a custom path with a .php extension in the cancellation_policy_url field, and inputs arbitrary PHP code in the cancellation_policy_html field. Upon submission, itm_hotel_booking_normalize_cancellation_policy_url() fails to validate the extension, causing itm_hotel_booking_write_cancellation_policy_file() to write the payload to booking/cancellation_policy/evil.php, which can then be directly executed.
findings.impact: Full Remote Code Execution (RCE) on the server, leading to server takeover and database compromise.
